entities.summary: Tarcisio Isao Kikuchi (b. 1958-11-01, Iwate Prefecture) was a entrepreneur or business leader of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Iwate Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, religious figures, asia.
